versions.changelog: Credential hygiene: the MCP config references ${MUMO_API_KEY} resolved from ~/.hermes/.env instead of carrying a literal-key placeholder. Adds an end-to-end 'hermes mcp test mumo' verification step and corrects the claim that a hub install registers the MCP server.
0.6.2: display name restored; install command uses the clawhub/mumo-hermes form the Hermes catalog generates.
0.6.1: install guidance corrected — hermes skills install mumo-hermes (ClawHub), not HermesHub. No tool or loop changes.
First registry release of the Hermes Agent skill: SKILL.md + config/mumo.yaml for the mumo MCP server (mcp_mumo_* tools).
